route.statement: D3D12 SM6, legacy GBuffer (r.Substrate=0), MegaLights disabled (r.MegaLights.EnableForProject=0), Lumen software tracing (r.Lumen.HardwareRayTracing=0), Virtual Shadow Maps enabled (r.Shadow.Virtual.Enable=1). r.RayTracing=1 only enables the project ray-tracing capability; r.RayTracing.Shadows=0 and Lumen HWRT is off. The active passes include Lumen ScreenProbe/Reflections TraceScreen+TraceVoxels, LumenReflections/ReflectionsResolve, and VirtualShadowMap page/raster passes. No Substrate or hardware-ray-tracing pass appears. MegaLights is off; only three MegaLights.LightPowerHistoryRatio clear-buffer passes remain, with no MegaLights shading/volume/trace pass.
